description.en: The bundled Node.js is updated to 24.22.1, which the latest OpenClaw requires. When an agent's newest release needs a newer Node.js than this device has, the newest compatible release is installed instead, including when the agent is added from the web.
description.zh: 内置 Node.js 升级至 24.22.1，满足最新版 OpenClaw 的要求。若智能体的最新版本需要更高版本的 Node.js，将自动安装可兼容的最新版本；从网页端添加智能体时同样适用。

title.en: Claude Code works through third-party relays
title.zh: Claude Code 可通过第三方中转正常使用

description.en: Requests are no longer rejected with "422 unknown variant tool_definition" by relays that do not support tool search.
description.zh: 不支持工具搜索的中转服务不再以「422 unknown variant tool_definition」拒绝请求。

title.zh: 智能体报错信息更清晰

description.en: Codex errors state the actual cause, such as a usage limit, rather than internal log lines. An incomplete Claude Code installation is identified as such, with instructions to reinstall, instead of "spawn EFTYPE". Codex recovers automatically after being reinstalled or updated. A connection test that receives a reply no longer reports a timeout because the CLI was slow to exit.
description.zh: Codex 报错直接说明实际原因（如额度已用完），不再显示内部日志。Claude Code 安装不完整时会明确提示并给出重装方法，不再只显示「spawn EFTYPE」。Codex 重装或更新后可自动恢复运行。连接测试已收到回复时，不再因 CLI 退出较慢而误报超时。
